text:
carol: Heads up — integration-e2e is red on main. The job fails when trying to push test artifacts to refs/heads/ci-temp with a 403. Full snippet from the runner:
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
error: failed to push some refs to 'https://github.com/redwood/repo.git'
```

alice: Is this the job that writes artifacts for cross-repo tests? @dave did we rotate any CI keys yesterday?

dave: Yeah — we rotated the infra deploy key for the ci-bot account. I thought the GH Actions secret CI_DEPLOY_KEY would be updated by the rotation script, but looks like the server key was replaced as read-only. Investigating now.

infra-bot: workflow 'integration-e2e' #147 failed — 403 on git push — rerun available: https://github.com/redwood/repo/actions/runs/123456789

carol: Can someone with admin perms check repo > Settings > Secrets & variables > Actions — ensure CI_DEPLOY_KEY and CI_TOKEN are present and the deploy key has write access? The job does: `git push https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.CI_TOKEN }}@github.com/redwood/repo.git refs/heads/ci-temp`

alice: Workaround: we can set SKIP_PUSH=true in the workflow to get downstream tests green, but that hides the artifact push step. Prefer to fix perms.

dave: Confirmed — the deploy key was accidentally added as read-only during rotation. I'll update it to allow write and recreate the CI_DEPLOY_KEY secret. Will ping when done.

ops-oncall: :eyes: Are we sure this is only the CI deploy key and not the prod deploy key used by deploy pipelines?

dave: Only the CI deploy key for the repo. Prod keys untouched. Updating now.

infra-bot: Secret updated in repo (audit id 67890).

carol: Thanks — I'm going to re-run the failing workflow. @alice can you trigger a rerun or should I?

alice: I can trigger it. Kicking off rerun: https://github.com/redwood/repo/actions/runs/123456789/attempts/1#re-run

infra-bot: workflow 'integration-e2e' rerun started.

infra-bot: workflow 'integration-e2e' #147 passed ✅ (artifacts pushed to refs/heads/ci-temp).

carol: Great — passing now. @dave can you add a quick checklist item to the key-rotation runbook to verify repo secret write perms and to run a smoke push?

dave: Yep will add a note to the infra runbook PR (linking in a sec).

ops-oncall: If we see >3 similar occurrences let's escalate and post a short note in #incidents so we can track recurrence.

alice: noting: follow-up ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-912

carol: Thanks everyone, closing the loop.
